records.fullReportTitle: National health registries in professional German football: development and first results from the men's and women's 1st and 2nd Bundesliga
validationEvidence: Real readable PDF, version 1.7, eight pages.
All five conference-record authors recur in the full report: Szymski, Krutsch, Huber, Weber and Alt.
Both sources describe the same prospective Bundesliga registry introduced for men in 2022/2023 with DFL and VBG support.
The conference record reports 503 injuries and 176 illnesses in the first male season. The full report reproduces those exact male counts and expands the registry with the women's cohort.
The full report describes the same monthly physician reporting, standardised forms, time-loss definition and longitudinal registry design.
The University of Regensburg repository labels the published version open access under CC BY-NC 4.0.
